status: PRELIMINARY — CONCEPTUAL DESIGN — NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION

hero.alt: Aerial concept of the Trojan Horse Arena: radiused concrete arena with two metal-building pop-outs

direction.title: Design direction
direction.text: The main arena takes its cues from the SRM Concrete corporate headquarters: radiused corners, no right angles, board-formed concrete, floor-to-deck glass and slender exposed columns. Metal-building pop-outs (storage annex and restroom core) are proposed as a Summertown Metals build. This is a concept study on the approved Phase 2 envelope (210 × 252 ft, 2 levels, 2,200 seats). No agreements are in place and no logos or marks are used.

updates.title: Exit recheck (P2-G-002 Rev E): doors and stairs pass, the NE tower is too small
updates.text: Level 2 sheet approved. The exit recheck on the curved plan passes on door capacity, stair capacity, travel distance and stair separation. One real problem: the 20 ft NE stair tower cannot hold the 76 in, 31-riser stair, which needs about 27 ft across. Recommended fix is a 29 ft drum, about 340 SF more per level. Not drawn yet; waiting on the owner. Assumptions only; architect confirms.

updates.title: P2-A-102 Rev G drawn: Level 2 inside the curved envelope
updates.text: Rev K approved. Level 2 plan on the project sheet format as a new file (Rev F stays frozen). The NE stair tower is entered from the north warm-up strip, and the running loop's NE corner is rounded so it stays 7 ft wide. Level 2 area is 28,692 SF and total is 86,212 GSF, about 420 more than Rev J. This corrects the Rev K sheet's Level 2 figure. Everything is assumed until the architect confirms.

updates.title: P2-A-101 Rev K drawn: curved envelope, 20 ft corners
updates.text: Level 1 block plan on the project sheet format, as a new file (Rev J stays frozen). Corner radius 20 ft. The SE and SW stairs slide along their walls, the NE stair is now a cylindrical tower inside the building envelope landing on the running loop, and a new 900 SF metal-building mech bay sits beside the storage annex, clear of the north exit. Level 1 footprint +659 SF, Level 2 -197 SF, total about +460 GSF. Everything is assumed until the architect confirms; the Level 2 sheet and exit capacity are the next rechecks.

updates.title: Plan Rev K study (now drawn as the sheet below)
updates.text: We measured what each corner radius removes from every Rev J element, not just rooms. At 34 ft the SE and SW stairs each lose about 190 of their 305 SF, so they would not fit. At 20 ft the corners remove about 343 SF per level, the two corner stairs slide along their walls instead of shrinking, and the corner mechanical rooms lose about 110 SF, made up in a new 900 SF metal-building mech bay beside the storage annex. Recommended radius: 20 ft. All positions are assumed until a plan revision is drawn.

updates.title: Interior cutaway and Level 1 plan
updates.text: The bowl as drawn in Set Rev D: 120 x 144 ft event floor, 4 mats, 1,100 telescopic lower seats, 1,100 fixed upper seats stepping down from the L2 running loop. This view uses the 34 ft corner radius of the first concept; the Rev K study below shows why 20 ft is the buildable radius.

updates.title: SRM-style arena with metal-building pop-outs
updates.text: New design language for the main arena. Approved Set Rev D is unchanged; these views are a concept study layered on the same envelope and heights.

upcoming.title: Resize the NE stair tower
upcoming.text: Redraw plan and Level 2 with a 29 ft stair drum, then carry areas to P2-G-003 Rev L.

upcoming.title: Structural review
upcoming.text: Curved shell, 120 ft roof span, and tier depth of 1'-6" or less.

upcoming.title: Parcel and code pre-application
upcoming.text: Site search, code edition and a conversation with the authority having jurisdiction.

upcoming.title: Champion Walk donor bricks
upcoming.text: Pricing for 4×8 single-name and 8×8 family-business bricks.

upcoming.title: Contractor pricing
upcoming.text: Get a contractor or estimator to price the approved set before any fundraising use.

upcoming.title: Trademark search
upcoming.text: Clear the Trojan Horse Arena name and badge.
